findings.title: Tasks skill description says a bug fix waits for the spec jury
quotes: Use after the plan jury approves (or, for a bug fix, after the spec jury does)
A bug fix's stage starts once `nio check spec <slug> --gate` passes (no spec jury)
findings.fix: change the description to name the gate check for a bug fix, as CT-7's Shape says.

sources.situation: a bug-fix spec passes `nio check spec --gate` and no spec jury runs. The skill's own description says the tasks stage comes after the spec jury, so a reader following the description waits for a jury that step 1 says is not needed.

findings.reason: skills/tasks/SKILL.md line 3 still says "or, for a bug fix, after the spec jury does", and the Inputs line says "a spec whose spec jury approved it", while step 1 (line 45) says a bug fix starts once `nio check spec <slug> --gate` passes with no spec jury; CT-7's Shape asks for the description and Inputs to change, and nothing else settles which wins. T-9 plans the description edit, but the file is inconsistent as it stands.

findings.title: Tasks skill has no escalation stop in step 4
quotes: **Verify, don't trust the reports.** Run `nio check tasks <slug>` yourself and fix every error
findings.fix: add the CT-7 stop to step 4 with its `grill.md` exception and the full-flow offer, or narrow CT-7 and FR-8 if this effort does not ship escalation.

sources.situation: CT-7 requires step 4 to stop on an `escalate:` note, unless `grill.md` already holds a `## Call · escalation declined` for that trigger, and to offer the full flow when the drafter stops over a new dependency, an interface used outside the bug's folder, or stored data. The step as written has none of this, and `grep` finds no `escalate:` or `Escalating a bug fix` in `skills/tasks/SKILL.md`. A bug fix that escalates would reach the drafter and tasks with no stop.

findings.reason: `grep escalat skills/tasks/SKILL.md` finds nothing, and step 4 (lines 46-47) is only "Verify, don't trust the reports", with no `escalate:` stop, no `grill.md` exception and no full-flow offer, all of which CT-7 requires. T-9 plans this stop ("stop on `escalate:` note and drafter stops"), so it is not yet done, but it is a real gap in the epic's state.
